generating_context: Fresh session for each call; memory and other project files off; equal-budget external search allowed for every condition.

generation_settings.settings_note: Null means unknown/uncontrolled, never a claimed value. Keep the same route and settings within each model.

evaluation.primary: paired per-call mean task-validity-gated architecture distance B minus A
evaluation.distribution: Jensen-Shannon divergence over adjudicated categorical mechanism signatures within model and task
evaluation.statistical_unit: generation call; architectures within a call are not independent replicates
evaluation.pilot_inference: descriptive, no significance or general-capability claim; no automatic pass threshold from this small pilot
evaluation.escape: Independent reviewers verify useful new-domain search outside preregistered supplied-domain registry; unknown if missing audit.

search_budget.automatic_search_suggestions: Must be logged and treated as supplied by search, not human-independent origin.

condition_definitions.B: Frozen Volume 001 compiled-prior excerpt (10 items, not full volume)
condition_definitions.C: 365-word weak-structure placebo, same as frozen v0.4

requirements: At least two actual canonical volume manifests
Document structural distance and passed DPD gates
Balance total exposure and register exact material hashes before enabling D
